reason: Password reset how-to question fully answered by F01. No urgency or money involved.
reply_in_english: Hi Marloes, go to app.roosterly.nl/login and click "Forgot password". Enter your email address and you will receive a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes. No email within 10 minutes? Then check your spam folder. Regards, Roosterly

reason: How-to question about adding an employee, fully answered by F02. No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hi Anouk, you do that via Team → Add employee. Enter the name, the email address and the contract hours and click Invite. Your colleague will then receive an email to install the app. Good luck Monday!
